info.name: Denmark Bike Nodes (Cykelknudepunkter)
info.description:
Fetches all numbered cycle-node-network waypoints (cykelknudepunkter) for all of Denmark from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API. Nodes are tagged with rcn_ref (regional cycle network reference) and/or network=rcn — the standard 'node network' tagging scheme used across DK/NL/BE.

Run 'All Bike Nodes - Denmark (Overpass main)' first. If overpass-api.de is slow/rate-limited, use the mirror request instead.

Note: a full-country query returns several thousand nodes and can take 30-90s server-side — the request timeout in this collection is set accordingly.

request.description: Overpass QL query scoped to the Denmark admin area (ISO3166-1=DK, admin_level=2), returning every node tagged rcn_ref or network=rcn. Response is Overpass JSON with an 'elements' array (id, lat, lon, tags).
Same query as the main request, routed to the Kumi Systems Overpass mirror. Use this if overpass-api.de is rate-limiting or timing out.

item.name: Bike Nodes - Single Municipality (example: Tønder Kommune)

request.description: Narrower example scoped to a single kommune. Swap the 'name' value to any Danish municipality. Useful for testing before running the full-country query, and matches the CycleNodeClient.get_by_municipality() behavior in geofa_cycle_nodes.py.
